text: BrennanAG protects against a server failing. It does nothing for a fire, a ransomware spread, or a mistake replicated instantly to both nodes. This video plans the backup strategy that still has to exist underneath it.
BrennanERP gets a weekly full, a daily differential, and a transaction log backup every fifteen minutes -- a cadence set by how much data loss Brennan can tolerate, not by convenience.

Backups land off-site via SQL Server's native backup-to-URL, into the offsite-backups container of the brennansqlbackups storage account, authenticated with a scoped SAS credential, not the full account key.

Full and differential backups run against SQLDBA02, marked COPY_ONLY. Seven days of local retention, thirty-five off-site, and every backup gets restored on a schedule with dbatools' Test-DbaLastBackup -- never just trusted.
The backup plan is set. Next: the performance baseline that has to exist before anyone starts tuning anything.
